loss-policy.description: Closed policy for every non-native fragment emitted by the v2-to-v3 preview migrator.

agent_capability.description: A free-standing agent capability has no local preview owner.

automatic_flow_contract.description: Automatic WhatsApp Flow behavior has no native preview contract.

await_resume_contract.description: Await token, correlation, duplicate, and late-delivery behavior has no native preview contract.

await_timeout_duration.description: The await deadline duration has no native preview contract.

duplicate_domain_row.description: A domain option has shadowed presentation rows.

duplicate_terminal_input_parameter.description: A terminal parameter has shadowed input bindings.

entry_contract.description: Entry initialization has no native preview contract.

implicit_await_capability.description: An await capability not owned by an explicit path step cannot be localized safely.

invalid_boolean_domain_field.description: A boolean domain contains a field outside its v2 contract.

invalid_non_choice_domain_field.description: A non-choice domain contains canonical option data that has no meaning for its type.

invalid_non_choice_synonyms.description: A non-choice domain contains choice-synonym normalization.

invalid_synonym_target.description: A normalization synonym targets no canonical domain option.

legacy_await_enrichment.description: A bare-name enrichment on an explicit await cannot lower into the executable object-form contract.

legacy_interactive_gate.description: A removed interactive environment gate cannot be restored into a valid current v2 source.

mismatched_interactive_domain.description: Interactive source-domain metadata disagrees with the slot domain localized by the preview.

orphan_domain_row.description: A domain presentation row has no matching canonical option.

shadowed_await_presentation.description: Path and capability presentation differ and the preview selects the path-owned form.

unknown_derive_anchor.description: A derive ordering anchor cannot be resolved to a localized preview step.

unknown_top_level_fragment.description: A source top-level field is outside the closed v2 schema.

unused_confirmation_contract.description: A valid v2 confirmation declaration is not consumed by the authored path.

unused_domain_declaration.description: A valid v2 domain declaration is not consumed by a localized collect step.

unused_override_gate.description: A valid v2 override gate is not consumed by a localized step.

unused_slot_declaration.description: A valid v2 slot declaration is not consumed by a localized collect step.

unused_subflow_declaration.description: A valid v2 subflow-use declaration is not consumed by the authored path.

unused_terminal_contract.description: A valid v2 terminal declaration is not consumed by the authored path.
